text:
Oliver Brooks: Heads-up invoice INV-2026-555 for Cumulus Data (acct CU-550) — customer was charged promotional credit and then also given a manual refund last week, looks like we double-credited. Net impact on invoice = -$2,450 but we only intended -$1,200. Can we do a corrective action? https://billing.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-555

Priya Kapoor: I pulled the export. Line items: 
- PROMO-ENT-50: -$1,200 (applied to usage)
- MANUAL-REFUND-2026-07-12: -$1,250 (refund issued previously via ACH)
file_note: Note: customer requested non-cash correction if possible to avoid refund reversal fees
text_continued:
Marcus Li: If the refund already went out via ACH then reversing will be painful. We can either issue a credit memo for -$1,250 to net out against the balance (preferred), or do a debit and collect cash back from customer which they don't want.

Tess Romero: Accounting prefers to issue CM-2026-121 for $1,250 and apply to INV-2026-555; include memo 'correct duplicate credit: PROMO + manual refund'. That way we avoid reversing ACH. Also attach proof of ACH payment and refund ticket.

Priya Kapoor: Proposed journal: 
``
Date: 2026-07-15
Debit: Promo Expense (GL 7205)     $1,250
Credit: Accounts Receivable       $1,250
Memo: Offset duplicate manual refund issued on 2026-07-12 for INV-2026-555 (CU-550)
```

Marcus Li: +1 accounting sign-off. Need approval from Tess (finance lead) to proceed as goodwill adjustment. Also flag payments team to block duplicate manual refunds for customers with active promo codes (sync with payments ops).

Tess Romero: Approved. Please create CM-2026-121 and mark 'no cash refund; adjustment only'. @Oliver add a short customer note explaining we applied an accounting adjustment rather than asking for return of funds.

payments-bot: CM-2026-121 created and applied to INV-2026-555. Journal JNL-100112 recorded.

Oliver Brooks: Customer notified via support ticket; they acknowledged and appreciate avoiding a second ACH transfer. Filing follow-up: ENG TICKET PAY-314 to add validation in refunds UI to warn when a promo is present.

Priya Kapoor: I'll run a quick query for other invoices where both 'PROMO' and 'MANUAL-REFUND' appear same billing period and post results in #finance a.m.

Tess Romero: Closing loop — finance will reconcile CM in July close. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
